name: 35178 · Vincent, AL
findings: ZIP 35178 (Vincent) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (80% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35178 (Vincent) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 35178 (Vincent) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.
